title: Yemen - Official Holidays (Multilingual: ar+en_US)
description: Comprehensive Yemen (اليمن / al-Yaman) official holidays from 1991 through 2030. All vacanza supported_languages: ar, en_US; all supported_categories: public, school, workday (public:738 / school:18 / workday:95). Country code YE. No subdivisions in vacanza (single national list). Generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) via holidays.YE(years=range(1991, 2031), language=L, categories=(C,), islamic_show_estimated=True) iteration over L in ('ar', 'en_US') and C in ('public', 'school', 'workday'). Suffixes for estimated/observed dates lifted into separate boolean flags (is_estimated=504, is_observed=92). Name collisions on the same date concatenated with '; ' (vacanza native behavior). Native Arabic preserved via ensure_ascii=False.
